newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.LANKA RUPEE ENDS FLAT ON LACK OF DOLLAR DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: S.LANKA RUPEE ENDS FLAT ON LACK OF DOLLAR DEMAND.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee ended steady versus the dollar on Thursday amid low dollar demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.92 to the dollar, they said.
"There was absolutely no demand for dollars in the market, and many banks sold the currency to the central bank," said a Deutsche Bank dealer.
The central bank left the dollar-rupee exchange rate unchanged, with buying and selling prices at 58.9149 and 60.1051, respectively.
Overnight call money closed at 10.75 percent after rising to 11.5 due to a slightly tight money market, dealers said.
"The shortage has been created by banks going to the central bank repo. But there is no cause for concern as overall, the market is very liquid," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
